rationale: This is the plan-owned immutable controller contract: timing reserves, heartbeat and staleness thresholds, attempt bound, and exact-decimal headroom. Grouping these coupled controller-wide limits prevents duplicating them across waves or provider records; the established declarative name is clear.
alternatives: Make it required once every valid plan must supply immutable controller bounds.
Merge individual timing fields into CampaignPlan only if there will never be another controller-level setting.
simplestChoice: Keep controller_policy as a closed ControllerPolicy object.
